newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Chained Bangladesh schoolboys allege rape, torture.
newsitem.headline: Chained Bangladesh schoolboys allege rape, torture.

text.p: Bangladesh police said on Monday they were investigating reports of child abuse in a religious school after rescuing 24 boys who alleged their teachers had chained, raped and tortured them.
Police said they raided the school on Sunday and rescued the children, all below the age of 14, chained and tied to heavy iron bars. They said eight more fled the school earlier.
"Most of us were subjected to molestation and rape by the teachers," said a 10-year-old boy, speaking from a police station in this southern port city where he remained in chains.
Police said they were still looking for blacksmiths to remove the chains. They said they had arrested the school principal and another teacher and were investigating the charges.
Police officers said child abuse was not a major problem in Bangladesh.
